# RantAI engineering guidelines

> How RantAI structures repositories, writes code and runs coding agents. This repository holds the
> rules (docs/), a project template (template/) and a model bench (bench/). If you are an AI agent
> asked to "use the RantAI guidelines" in some project, do not read everything here: follow the
> skill below.

## If you are an agent asked to set a project up

- [The setup skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RantAI-dev/guidelines/main/skill/rantai-guidelines/SKILL.md): the complete procedure. New project, existing project, refactor, language migration.
- One command does the installing: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RantAI-dev/guidelines/main/install.sh | bash -s -- adopt .` (or `new <dir>`).

## Documents, when you need the reason for a rule

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RantAI-dev/guidelines/main/README.md): the map and the short version.
- [docs/desk-thread.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RantAI-dev/guidelines/main/docs/desk-thread.md): running a project from one thread.
- [docs/orchestration.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RantAI-dev/guidelines/main/docs/orchestration.md): lead, workers, reviewer, models and routes.
- [docs/no-read-workflow.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RantAI-dev/guidelines/main/docs/no-read-workflow.md): shipping code nobody reads line by line.
- [docs/changing-code.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RantAI-dev/guidelines/main/docs/changing-code.md): refactoring an existing repository; porting to another language.
- [docs/tracker.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RantAI-dev/guidelines/main/docs/tracker.md): the backlog in the repository, and the optional Lark copy.
- [docs/engineering.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RantAI-dev/guidelines/main/docs/engineering.md): 23 rules for code, tests and comments.
- [template/docs/conventions.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RantAI-dev/guidelines/main/template/docs/conventions.md): the rules that are the same in every codebase: error body, statuses, error codes, messages, field names, lists, logs, configuration, commits. Every project has a copy at docs/conventions.md.
- [docs/conventions.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RantAI-dev/guidelines/main/docs/conventions.md): the reason for each of those rules.
- [docs/agent-context.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RantAI-dev/guidelines/main/docs/agent-context.md): what each agent harness reads.
- [docs/lead-budget.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RantAI-dev/guidelines/main/docs/lead-budget.md): spending less of the lead model.
